cohort: The cohort consisted of 2,963 women from a family planning clinic who had undergone at least one cervical cytology screening between 1990 and 2017.
finding: IUD use was associated with a lower risk of abnormal cervical cytology.
mod_finding: A history of caesarean delivery was associated with a lower incidence of abnormal cervical cytology, with a 24.9% reduction in risk per additional caesarean.
